# Skein 0.6

Skein is a tiny zero-dependency HTML-first Web Components runtime with fine-grained native-DOM reactivity.

Canonical sources:
- README.md — user-facing guide and migration notes
- llms-full.txt — complete machine-oriented model
- .agents/skills/skein/references/syntax.md — exact syntax
- .agents/skills/skein/references/architecture.md — runtime invariants
- examples/studio/ — multi-file component composition reference

Core model:
- component tags map to HTML files: `<user-card>` → `user/card.html`;
- source is fetched before Skein claims an unknown custom-element tag;
- component `this` is reactive state;
- recursively reactive values are arrays and plain/null-prototype objects only;
- Date/Map/Set/DOM/platform/class instances stay native/opaque;
- shared raw objects keep one Skein Proxy identity across components;
- bindings are strict paths: `{user.name}`, `.value={name}`, `?disabled={saving}`, `@click={save}`;
- derived logic belongs in `computed()`;
- lists use `each={items}` and usually `key={id}`;
- native `for={inputId}` is an ordinary dynamic attribute;
- `in={...}` was removed in 0.6; use full paths;
- conditions use `if={visible}`;
- child inputs use `input('value', fallback)` and owner `.value={state}`;
- child outputs use bubbling/composed native `CustomEvent`;
- disconnect pauses; `host.dispose()` permanently destroys;
- cleanup uses `onCleanup()` or `abortSignal`;
- no virtual DOM, SSR, hydration, suspense, event bus, public batch/signal/untrack/stats/flush APIs.

Public API: `Skein.version`, `Skein.define(tag, source)`.
